english.title: Permit use of motor vehicles fitted with mixed tyres on steerable and driven axles
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, NAMELY **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a wheeled vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), the

(A)_[steerable ]_
(B)_[driven]_

axles of which were not fitted with pneumatic tyres of the same type of structure.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 26(4) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

(A)_[driven]_

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale in any other case.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

discretionary disqualification.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
